content.value: In a machining operation that approximates orthogonal cutting, the cutting tool has a rake angle of 10°. The chip thickness before cut, $\mathfrak { t } _ { \mathfrak { o } } = 0$ .5mm and the chip thickness after cut, $\mathfrak { t } _ { \mathfrak { c } } = 1$ .125mm. Calculate the shear plane angle and the shear strain in the operation.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
